surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky header and floating cards: bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10
Tracing Beam / Aceternity effect for primary product cards: glowing border that travels around the edge.
Neo-Brutalist touches in the grid: 1px borders, sharp edges, no soft shadows, purely ambient glow.
textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to remove digital flatness.
motion: Masked line-by-line reveal on load for the Hero H1 using Framer Motion.
Framer-motion scroll-reveals (staggered fade-up) for grids and lists.
Micro-interactions: Buttons have a slight scale-up on hover and inner glow.
Slow editorial marquee (infinite scroll) separating hero and about.

layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen) with central alignment, massive kinetic typography, glowing call-to-action.
layouts.bento_grid: Mode A (Tetris Grid) for 'Areas of Expertise'. cols-1 md:cols-12. Mix of col-span-4, col-span-8 to create asymmetry.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Large mono-spaced numbers on the left (col-span-4), rich text on the right (col-span-8).
layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.

sections_to_build.name: Header
sections_to_build.instructions: Sticky header, Glassmorphism (bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md). Logo on left, nav links (Início, Sobre, Produtos, Áreas de Atuação, Contato) centered, CTA right.

sections_to_build.name: Hero
sections_to_build.instructions: Kinetic typography for slogan 'Africon — GovTech de Inteligência Artificial, Dados e Software de Gestão para transformar informação em melhores decisões públicas'. Masked line-by-line reveal via framer-motion. Buttons: 'Conheça nossas soluções'. Abstract 3D/particle background or simple glowing gradient if 3D is heavy.

sections_to_build.name: Editorial Marquee
sections_to_build.instructions: Slow continuous scroll using react-fast-marquee. Text: 'Inteligência Artificial • Dados • Software de Gestão • Decisões Públicas'. Font: mono or wide sans, transparent text with 1px stroke.

sections_to_build.name: About / Manifesto
sections_to_build.instructions: Numbered chapters (01. Nossa Visão, 02. O Desafio, 03. A Solução). Large text, scroll-triggered fade-ins. Use geometric glass architecture image as accent.

sections_to_build.name: Products Showcase
sections_to_build.instructions: Two massive sections. First for E-Quidade (Educação) using dashboard UI image. Second for XGovControl-IEG-M (Gestão Municipal). Overlay text on dark transparent cards. Reveal on scroll.

sections_to_build.name: Complementarity
sections_to_build.instructions: Visual flow showing how E-Quidade + XGovControl integrate. Use abstract data waves image in background.

sections_to_build.name: Areas of Expertise Grid
sections_to_build.instructions: 6 cards (governança, educação, indicadores municipais, gestão de evidências, análise de documentos, inteligência aplicada) in a Tetris Bento Grid. Hover effects: border glows, icons lift.

sections_to_build.name: Benefits
sections_to_build.instructions: List of GovTech benefits with modern iconography, staggered entrance animations on scroll.

sections_to_build.name: Contact / Demo
sections_to_build.instructions: Mocked visual form. 'Solicite uma demonstração'. Modern input fields with cyan focus rings. Glowing submit button.

sections_to_build.name: Footer
sections_to_build.instructions: Massive py-32 padding. Huge 'AFRICON' logo at the bottom. Links and legal text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients or images has sufficient drop-shadow or overlay (bg-slate-950/50).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the line-by-line reveals and marquee.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive buttons and links MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Install required dependencies via yarn if missing: framer-motion, lucide-react, @phosphor-icons/react, react-fast-marquee, clsx, tailwind-merge, @studio-freight/react-lenis.
Contact form must be visual demo only (mocked), no backend integration needed.
